planted.text: Agreed on doing the id write on completion. Half the providers hand you back a batch object that goes to failed or expired within a minute of submit, and if we've already got that id sitting on disk every rerun goes and polls a dead job. Completion is the only point where the id means something, so that's where it gets recorded.
planted.settles: the id is only recorded at completion so no unconfirmed batch id ever lands on disk
